Question: According to the bring down provision, when are representations and warranties required to be made?
Option A: At Signing Only
Option B: At Signing & At Closing

Merger Agreement: Section 10.5 Conditions to Obligations of Parent and Subsidiaries. (a) Representations and Warranties. Each representation and warranty made by the Company shall be deemed effective as of the Signing Date and, unless expressly limited to that date, must be reconfirmed as of the Closing Date pursuant to the bring down provision.

Section 10.5(b) Further Clarifications. Notwithstanding the general rule, representations and warranties specifically identified in Paragraph 10.5(a)(ii) concerning financial condition and contingent liabilities require a one-time affirmation at the Signing Date only, provided that no material adverse change occurs prior to Closing. (Page 158)
